info.name: Kairos & Emotion Analysis Face Recognition API
Enroll a face into a gallery

items.docs: Takes a photo, finds the faces within it, and stores the faces into a gallery under a subject identifier you choose. Submit the photo as a publicly accessible URL, Base64-encoded image, or file upload.

info.name: Verify a face against an enrolled subject

items.docs: Takes a photo and compares it against a specific subject already enrolled in a gallery. Use the returned confidence value to decide whether the match is valid for your application.
Takes a photo, finds the faces within it, and matches them against all subjects enrolled in a gallery, returning candidate matches above the matching threshold (default 60%).
Takes a photo and returns the facial features it finds as coordinates, plus attributes such as age, gender and glasses. Coordinates begin at the top-left of the photo.
